commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: capture-boot-baseline"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s

echo "STEP: create-datauser"
sudo -n useradd -m -d /home/datauser datauser
id datauser

echo "STEP: create-srv-data"
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n chown datauser:datauser /srv/data
sudo -n chmod 750 /srv/data
ls -ld /srv/data

echo "STEP: current-grub-cmdline"
cat /etc/default/grub | grep GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX

echo "STEP: set-rootflags-pquota"
sudo -n grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="rootflags=pquota"
sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep -E "^(kernel|args)" || true

echo "STEP: update-fstab"
sudo -n cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak
sudo -n sed -i 's|\(UUID=21114daa-c867-4340-97b6-9343d05891b6 /  *xfs\)  *defaults|\1     pquota|' /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab

echo "STEP: done-pre-reboot-setup"

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: verify-mount-pquota"
mount | grep 'on / '
findmnt -no OPTIONS /

echo "STEP: verify-datauser-and-dir"
id datauser
ls -ld /srv/data

echo "STEP: configure-project"
sudo -n bash -c 'grep -q "^100:/srv/data" /etc/projects || echo "100:/srv/data" >> /etc/projects'
sudo -n bash -c 'grep -q "^datauser:100" /etc/projid || echo "datauser:100" >> /etc/projid'
cat /etc/projects
cat /etc/projid

echo "STEP: set-project-and-limit"
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'project -s datauser' /
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'limit -p bhard=100m datauser' /

echo "STEP: report"
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'report -p -h' /

echo "STEP: test-under-limit"
sudo -n -u datauser dd if=/dev/zero of=/srv/data/small.bin bs=1M count=50 status=none && echo "small write OK"

echo "STEP: test-over-limit"
sudo -n -u datauser dd if=/dev/zero of=/srv/data/big.bin bs=1M count=80 2>&1 | tail -5 || true
echo "big write exit handled"

echo "STEP: post-test-report"
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'report -p -h' /
df -h /srv/data
